chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 — Primary Source (3 points) — Set 1: nineteenth-century passage
chunks.content: AP World History SAQ 2 (Primary Source), 3 points, one per part. Set 1 prompts: A [1] identify one likely audience for the author's claims; B [1] describe one historical context during the nineteenth century that explains the passage; C [1] explain how one ideology or set of ideas likely influenced the author's claims. 'Identify' = correct answer; 'Describe' = relevant characteristics; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: A naming the author instead of an audience; C naming an ideology without explaining its influence on the claims.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 1) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Identified a likely audience, described a relevant nineteenth-century context, and explained how an ideology influenced the author's claims. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 1) scored 2/3 (A 1, B 1, C 0). Identified the audience (A) and described a context (B) but did not explain how an ideology influenced the claims (C). Illustrates losing the Explain part.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 1) scored 1/3 (A 1, B 0, C 0). Identified an audience only. Lost B (no valid context) and C (no ideology explanation). Illustrates a response confined to identifying the audience.
